name: @iwsdk/reference

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Semantic search across IWSDK and dependency code. Best for finding relevant code by description, use case, or functionality. Returns code chunks ranked by relevance.

query.description: Natural language search query (e.g., "how to create a VR session", "XR controller input handling")

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

source.description: Filter by source: ["iwsdk", "deps"]. Omit to search all sources.

verbosity.description: Content verbosity level: 0=metadata only, 1=first 10 lines, 2=first 30 lines, 3=full content (default: 3)

tools.name: find_by_relationship
tools.description: Find code by structural relationships. Use this to find all classes that extend/implement something, code that imports/calls specific functions, or uses WebXR APIs.

target.description: The target to search for (e.g., "Component" for extends, "XRSession" for uses_webxr_api)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20)

tools.name: get_api_reference
tools.description: Quick lookup of API by name. Use this when you know the class/function/interface name and want to see its implementation and documentation.

name.description: Name of the class, function, interface, or type to look up

source.description: Filter by source: ["iwsdk", "deps"]. Omit to search all sources.

tools.name: get_file_content
tools.description: Read the full content of a source file. Useful for seeing complete file context beyond code snippets.

file_path.description: Relative path to the file (e.g., "packages/core/src/index.ts" or "@types/three/index.d.ts")

tools.name: list_ecs_components
tools.description: List all ECS (Entity Component System) components in the codebase.

source.description: Filter by source: ["iwsdk"]. Omit to list all.

limit.description: Maximum number of components to return (default: 100)

tools.name: list_ecs_systems
tools.description: List all ECS (Entity Component System) systems in the codebase.

source.description: Filter by source: ["iwsdk"]. Omit to list all.

limit.description: Maximum number of systems to return (default: 100)

tools.name: find_dependents
tools.description: Find code that depends on a given API (reverse dependency lookup). Answers "what uses this API?"

api_name.description: Name of the API to find dependents for

dependency_type.description: Type of dependency to search for (default: "any")

limit.description: Maximum number of dependents to return (default: 20)

tools.name: find_usage_examples
tools.description: Find real-world usage examples of an API. Prioritizes code that actually imports and uses the API, not just type definitions. Perfect for understanding how to use a specific API.

api_name.description: Name of the API to find usage examples for (e.g., "Component", "createComponent", "XRSession")

limit.description: Maximum number of examples to return (default: 10)
